key: We're sorry; admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
en: We're sorry; admittance to the apartments is for tenants only.
ja: 申し訳ありません。この集合住宅は　住人以外　立ち入れません

key: Um, hello? Is someone there?
en: Um, hello? Is someone there?
ja: あの　すみません? どなたか　いますか?

key: I apologize for the issue with the electricity...
en: I apologize for the issue with the electricity...
ja: 電気の不具合は　申し訳ありません……

key: Something seems to be sapping this building's power.
en: Something seems to be sapping this building's power.
ja: 何かが　この建物の電気を　吸い取っているようで

key: I think it's over to the right...?
en: I think it's over to the right...?
ja: たぶん　右のほうだと　思うんですが……?

key: Well this has been a real nuisance...
en: Well this has been a real nuisance...
ja: まったく　困ったことに　なりました……

key: Yikes, I've been spotted!
en: Yikes, I've been spotted!
ja: うわっ　見つかっちまった!

key: And by \PN of all people!
en: And by \PN of all people!
ja: よりによって　\PNに!

key: Wait, don't pull out those Pokéballs--
en: Wait, don't pull out those Pokéballs--
ja: 待った! モンスターボールは　しまってくれ――

key: I'm living an honest life now, promise!
en: I'm living an honest life now, promise!
ja: オレは今　まっとうに生きてるんだ　本当だぜ!

key: Just don't ask why I'm still in uniform...
en: Just don't ask why I'm still in uniform...
ja: なんで　まだ制服を着てるかは　聞かないでくれ……

key: Clothes are expensive, you know?
en: Clothes are expensive, you know?
ja: 服って　高いんだよ?

key: You know, if you let me off the hook, I'll tell you something interesting!
en: You know, if you let me off the hook, I'll tell you something interesting!
ja: なあ　見逃してくれたら　面白いことを教えてやるよ!

key: The next time someone asks you for a password, you could tell them "pulse2"!
en: The next time someone asks you for a password, you could tell them "pulse2"!
ja: 今度　パスワードを聞かれたら「pulse2」って答えるといい!

key: This'll make all of your opponents have busted EVs from the very get-go!
en: This'll make all of your opponents have busted EVs from the very get-go!
ja: そうすりゃ　最初から　相手全員の努力値が　ぶっ壊れになるぜ!

key: Huh? Why would you want to do that?
en: Huh? Why would you want to do that?
ja: え? なんで　そんなことするのかって?

key: Don't ask ME something like that-- I'm just passing on the info!
en: Don't ask ME something like that-- I'm just passing on the info!
ja: オレに聞くなよ――こっちは　情報を伝えてるだけだ!

key: Hello? Is someone there?
en: Hello? Is someone there?
ja: もしもし? 誰かいるの?

key: Unfortunately we're kind of having an outage right now...
en: Unfortunately we're kind of having an outage right now...
ja: あいにく　今　停電中でして……

key: I WISH I could say it was an accident, but there's a Pokémon in here sucking up all the power!
en: I WISH I could say it was an accident, but there's a Pokémon in here sucking up all the power!
ja: 事故だと言いたいけど　中で　電気を吸い取ってるポケモンがいるの!

key: If you can find it, please do something about it!
en: If you can find it, please do something about it!
ja: 見つけられたら　どうにかしてちょうだい!

key: If you can find the Pokémon sucking up our power, please do something about it!
en: If you can find the Pokémon sucking up our power, please do something about it!
ja: 電気を吸い取ってるポケモンを見つけたら　どうにかしてちょうだい!

key: If it's that hungry, maybe bring something for it to eat instead?
en: If it's that hungry, maybe bring something for it to eat instead?
ja: そんなにお腹がすいてるなら　何か食べ物を持ってきたら?

key: Thank god it's gone.
en: Thank god it's gone.
ja: いなくなってくれて　助かったわ

key: Hello, darling!
en: Hello, darling!
ja: あら　こんにちは!

key: Have you been contributing to the city restoration project?
en: Have you been contributing to the city restoration project?
ja: 街の復興プロジェクトには　協力してる?

key: It's important that everyone does their fair share, so get on to the Grand Hall and sign up if you haven't already!
en: It's important that everyone does their fair share, so get on to the Grand Hall and sign up if you haven't already!
ja: みんなが　できることをするのが　大事なの。まだなら　大ホールで　登録してきてね!

key: The Pokémon leapt for your PokéSnax!
en: The Pokémon leapt for your PokéSnax!
ja: ポケモンが　ポケスナックに　飛びついた!

key: Something seems to be sucking power out of an outlet...
en: Something seems to be sucking power out of an outlet...
ja: 何かが　コンセントから　電気を吸っているようだ……

key: It's too dark to see, and doesn't seem to respond on its own...
en: It's too dark to see, and doesn't seem to respond on its own...
ja: 暗くて見えない。自分からは　反応しないようだ……

key: Something seems to be lurking in the darkness...
en: Something seems to be lurking in the darkness...
ja: 暗がりに　何かが　ひそんでいるようだ……
